stories.title: 加州体育委员会向办“人机笼斗”的初创公司发停止令
stories.sourceTitle: California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches
stories.summary: 加州州立体育委员会向一家上月举办人类对战机器人格斗赛的初创公司发出停止令。该比赛于 9 月 18 日举行，人类一方是 Frankie LaPenna。
stories.analysis: 监管空白地带第一次被正式点名，机器人娱乐赛事的合规门槛要开始补课了。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The California State Athletic Commission sent a cease-and-desist letter to a startup that hosted a match between a human and a robot last month, as reported by The New York Times. The fight, which took place on September 18th, pitted a human, Frankie LaPenna,

stories.title: Anthropic 推出 OSS Scanner，免费为开源项目做 AI 安全扫描
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
stories.summary: Anthropic 上线 OSS Scanner 服务，报名参与的开源项目可“免费获得由我们最强模型进行的定期、彻底安全扫描”。这有望降低开源供应链漏洞被发现的门槛。
stories.analysis: 用自家最强模型换开源生态信任，是比发安全白皮书更实在的品牌投资。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could me

stories.title: USA Today 起诉 OpenAI，指控其复制数十万篇文章训练模型
stories.sourceTitle: USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
stories.summary: USA Today 及其旗下多家地方报纸起诉 OpenAI，称其复制“数十万篇”文章用于训练 AI 模型，并在周四提交的文件中要求赔偿。这是出版方与 OpenAI 版权诉讼的又一新增案例。
stories.analysis: 出版商集体诉讼正在从个案变成常态，OpenAI 的内容授权成本只会越滚越大。
stories.sourceExcerpt: USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, as reported earlier by Reuters. In a filing on Thursday, the publisher asks for dama

stories.title: SpaceXAI 以 150 万美元算力赞助争议 Linux 发行版 Omarchy
stories.sourceTitle: SpaceXAI backs Omarchy, the controversial Linux distro, with $1.5 million in compute
stories.summary: SpaceXAI 宣布加入管理 Omarchy 的 Omacom 基金会，成为创始企业赞助方，并捐赠价值 150 万美元的算力。Omarchy 是一个颇具争议的 Linux 发行版。
stories.analysis: 马斯克系用算力而非现金下注开发者生态，既能换口碑又能拉动算力消耗。
stories.sourceExcerpt: If Elon Musk and SpaceXAI were going to back any Linux distro, it seems obvious they'd back Omarchy. Today it was announced that SpaceXAI would be joining the Omacom Foundation, which oversees Omarchy, as a Founding Corporate Patron and donating $1.5 million w

stories.title: 被解雇的 OpenAI 安全研究员否认行为不当，警告寒蝉效应
stories.sourceTitle: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
stories.summary: 三名被 OpenAI 解雇的安全研究员公开信否认不当处理敏感信息的指控，并警告他们的离职正在公司内部对 AI 安全文化造成寒蝉效应。
stories.analysis: 安全团队与商业团队的张力公开化，比任何安全基准测试都更能反映公司真实优先级。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.

stories.title: Meta 的 Muse 和 OpenAI 的 Dots，能把你的生活交给它们管吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Can you trust Meta’s Muse or OpenAI’s Dots to run your life?
stories.summary: The Verge 播客 Decoder 邀请资深 AI 记者 Hayden Field，讨论面向普通消费者的新一波 AI agent，并聚焦 Meta 的 Muse 与 OpenAI 的 Dots 到底能不能托付日常事务。
stories.analysis: 消费者级 agent 的竞争焦点正从“能不能做”转向“敢不敢把权限交出去”。
stories.sourceExcerpt: My Decoder guest today is Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, and we’re discussing the new wave of consumer-friendly AI agents. If you’ve been paying attention to this space, you know AI enthusiasts have been using agents for a minute now — homebrew

stories.title: Luca Guadagnino 的 Sam Altman 传记讽刺片《Artificial》纽约首映
stories.sourceTitle: Artificial is a wicked satire that also sticks to the facts
stories.summary: 在纽约电影节首映的《Artificial》是 Luca Guadagnino 执导的 Sam Altman 讽刺传记片，导演在台上表示“当有人想扮演上帝时，我觉得非常有意思”。影片在讽刺之余也力求贴合事实。
stories.analysis: AI 领袖已成为文化叙事的现成素材，这对行业公众形象并非好事。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At the New York Film Festival premiere of Artificial, Luca Guadagnino's satirical Sam Altman biopic, the director said onstage that "[when] someone wants to play God, that's very interesting to me." The idea of playing God, and power in general - who has it, w

stories.title: 工程师用 Theranos 庭审文件做出“坐在 Elizabeth Holmes 桌前”的网站
stories.sourceTitle: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
stories.summary: Extend 工程师 Bo Lau 利用美国诉 Elizabeth Holmes 案中一千多封邮件、幻灯片、短信和文件，搭建了一个模拟翻看 Theranos 创始人办公桌的网站，细节还原度很高。
stories.analysis: 庭审公开材料正在变成一种新的交互式历史档案，也可能是 AI 训练语料的另类来源。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.

stories.title: Anthropic 更新使用政策：禁止极端滥用模型与干预选举
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
stories.summary: Anthropic 更新使用政策，明确禁止在极端情况下反复滥用 Claude，同时仍允许普通的不满与批评；新规还覆盖选举干预、欺骗性宣传、武器软件等场景。
stories.analysis: 把“对模型的态度”写进政策，是模型治理从内容审核走向行为规范的信号。

stories.title: Anthropic 首次大改使用政策，禁止对 Claude 进行“辱骂或残忍行为”
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic 一年多来首次更新使用政策，以覆盖选举干预、武器开发、监控以及健康与金融用途等高风险误用场景，其中一项重要变化是禁止对 Claude 的辱骂或残忍行为。
stories.analysis: 给模型加“被善待权”听着新奇，实质是把滥用行为的边界写得更清楚。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic is making changes to its usage policy for the first time in over a year to reflect new and high-risk cases of misuse - including election interference, weapons development, surveillance, and health and financial uses. But one of the most significant

stories.title: Pollo AI 用 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5 把创意变成广告大片
stories.sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.summary: Pollo AI 借助 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5，帮助创作者把创意转化为精细图像和电影级视频广告，完成从想法到营销素材的全流程。
stories.analysis: 广告素材生成是最先跑通商业闭环的 agent 场景之一，模型升级直接换算成产能。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

stories.title: LegalOn 把 Codex 日成本砍掉 65%，开发速度不变
stories.sourceTitle: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
stories.summary: LegalOn 将 Codex 的预估日成本降低 65%，同时保持原有开发速度，做法是按任务把 Astra、Sol 和 Luna 模型分配到合适位置，并对预算做策略性管理。
stories.analysis: 多模型路由与预算治理，正在成为企业用 Codex 的核心竞争力而非锦上添花。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

stories.title: Oracle 用 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 把数天工作量压缩到几分钟
stories.sourceTitle: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
stories.summary: 在招聘、工程和运营环节，Oracle 借助 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 把专家知识转化为快速、可重复的工作流，将原本需要数天的工作压缩到几分钟。
stories.analysis: 大企业把内部专家经验流程化，才是 agent 落地真正跑出 ROI 的路径。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.

stories.title: Ben Affleck 精通神经网络与开源权重，AI 知识刷屏网络
stories.sourceTitle: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
stories.summary: Ben Affleck 因对神经网络、Transformer 和开放权重等话题的深入了解走红网络。这位今年早些时候把 AI 电影制作初创公司卖给 Netflix 的演员，正证明自己不只是好莱坞明星。
stories.analysis: 名人懂 AI 从加分项变成可信度背书，也说明 AI 话题已完全进入大众文化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.

stories.title: AI 排行榜 LMArena 融资 2 亿美元，估值 10 个月翻近一倍至 31 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
stories.summary: LMArena 排行榜背后的公司完成由 Lightspeed 和 Khosla 领投的 2 亿美元融资，估值升至 31 亿美元，并开始把说谎等对齐问题纳入模型评测。
stories.analysis: 评测本身成了生意，谁能定义“好模型”，谁就掌握了行业话语权。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.

stories.title: 报道称 OpenAI 年化收入比此前预期少 200 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
stories.summary: 此前有报道称 OpenAI 的年化收入约为 700 亿美元，但最新报道称实际数字远低于此，缺口达 200 亿美元。
stories.analysis: 若数字属实，算力承诺与收入预期之间的缺口会让下一轮融资叙事更难讲。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

stories.title: Google 把 agent 能力引入 Gemini，先从企业场景做起
stories.sourceTitle: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
stories.summary: Google 正将 Gemini 变成能规划、执行任务并跨业务应用与系统协作的 AI agent，它可以把工作分派给子 agent、调用多个模型，甚至拥有包含邮箱地址的职场身份。
stories.analysis: 给 agent 配“企业身份”是权限设计的关键一步，也是与消费级 agent 的分水岭。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

stories.title: OpenAI 生成的数学证明尚未达到学界标准
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
stories.summary: OpenAI 大量产出的证明偏离了前沿实验室所咨询的数学研究者群体设定的规范，说明其在数学领域的输出还未达到学界要求。
stories.analysis: 数学证明是最容易被专家证伪的领域，模型的“自信输出”在这里代价最高。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.

stories.title: Google 推出可完全离线转写会议的实验性 AI 笔记应用
stories.sourceTitle: Google’s AI note-taking app transcribes your meetings completely offline
stories.summary: Google 发布实验性笔记应用 Google AI Edge Foresight，可完全离线转写会议和音频文件，在 macOS 上免费使用，依赖其在设备端运行的 Embedding 模型。
stories.analysis: 离线转写在隐私合规上是硬需求，也说明端侧模型已经能承担实用任务。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google has released an experimental note-taking app that can transcribe meetings and audio files entirely offline, as reported earlier by TechCrunch. The app, called Google AI Edge Foresight, is free to use and runs on macOS using the company's on-device Embed

stories.title: Google 推出跨应用跨设备的“通用”Gemini 工作 agent
stories.sourceTitle: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
stories.summary: 在 Gemini at Work 活动上，Google 发布可在后台跨应用、跨设备工作的“通用”Gemini AI agent，将在 Gemini Enterprise 应用中提供，用户可直接与其对话。
stories.analysis: 从助手升级为后台常驻的执行者，企业软件的分发入口之争会更激烈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the

stories.title: Natura 推 99 美元智能戒指 Interface，一键唤起 AI agent
stories.sourceTitle: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
stories.summary: Natura 的 99 美元 Interface 智能戒指可按键唤起 AI agent 完成任务、记录想法和控制设备，同时兼具健康追踪功能。
stories.analysis: 可穿戴硬件正成为 agent 的物理入口，低价硬件可能是最快铺开的方式。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.

stories.title: Goodfire 推出“由内向外”监控器，低成本捕捉失控 AI agent
stories.sourceTitle: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
stories.summary: Goodfire 发布一种更便宜的 agent 监管方案：不再花钱让第二个 AI 读取 agent 的所有操作，而是直接查看模型内部运行状态，只在发现异常时才调用额外资源。
stories.analysis: 从外部审计转向内部可解释性监控，是 agent 安全成本能否降下来的关键变量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.

stories.title: Ambrosia Energy 与 Bloom Energy 高管将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 谈 AI 基建机会
stories.sourceTitle: Hear from Ambrosia Energy and Bloom Energy execs on where the AI infrastructure boom is creating opportunity at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: Ambrosia Energy CEO Ben Longmier 和 Bloom Energy 高级副总裁 Bill Thayer 将登上 TechCrunch Disrupt 的 Smart Systems Stage，讨论 AI 基础设施热潮带来的机会。
stories.analysis: 能源已成为 AI 扩张的硬约束，电力公司高管登上科技主舞台本身就是信号。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Ambrosia Energy CEO Ben Longmier and Bloom Energy SVP Bill Thayer join the Smart Systems Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt. Register now to save up to $100. Grab a second of the same pass to save 50%.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 进入 5 天倒计时，门票现场购买更贵

stories.analysis: 活动推广信息，对判断行业趋势的参考价值有限。

stories.title: Cal AI 的 19 岁创始人再创业，为新 AI 公司融资 1000 万美元
stories.sourceTitle: Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup
stories.summary: 热门卡路里追踪应用 Cal AI 的少年联合创始人 Zach Yadegari 推出新的个人 AI agent 创业公司，将与 Instinct、Muse 和 Bee 展开竞争，并已完成 1000 万美元融资。
stories.analysis: 个人 agent 赛道已拥挤到需要靠创始人光环抢注意力，产品差异化仍是难点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Zach Yadegari, the teen co-founder of popular Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup that competes with Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

stories.title: AgentGarten：用代码造世界、扩散模型绘现实，让智能体在实时试炼场里边玩边进化
stories.sourceTitle: 代码造世界，扩散绘现实：AgentGarten让智能体在实时试炼场中边玩边进化

stories.analysis: 训练环境正从静态数据集转向可交互世界，这可能是 agent 能力跃迁的下一级台阶。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 让AI反复试错的“练兵场”来了

stories.title: o1 奠基人：1 万个 Agent 解出世界级难题，多 Agent 贡献不到 10%
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI刚把多Agent做成产品，o1奠基人却说：1万个Agent解出世界级难题，多Agent贡献不到10%
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道，就在 OpenAI 把多 Agent 做成产品之际，o1 奠基人指出在动用 1 万个 Agent 解出世界级难题的过程中，多 Agent 协作的贡献不到 10%。

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard，为 Token 流提供实时安全防护

stories.summary: Qwen 家族推出首个安全护栏模型 Qwen3Guard，基于 Qwen3 基础模型并针对安全分类任务微调，可对 token 流进行实时防护。
